findings.claim: The badge parser fix addresses the recorded false zero.
findings.evidence: SeoView renders history.length in exactly one span.tabular-nums inside the uniquely titled history button. The test selects that span and validates /^[0-9]+$/; this regex has no backslash to be consumed by the surrounding template literal. A missing, duplicate, or malformed span yields null, which cannot satisfy row-count equality.

findings.claim: History and identity acceptance remain strong.
findings.evidence: The opened list must be visible, its row count must equal the parsed badge, and historyIdentities must contain the checkpoint's exact Save response ID. Close/reopen, unique row label, snapshot ID equality, Live return, new document timeOrigin, and post-reload history and snapshot ID checks remain in the source.

findings.claim: The repair preserves one-write and privacy boundaries.
findings.evidence: The change only observes a rendered span. The existing checkpoint precedes the sole Save click; a resumed checkpoint with an observed ID takes the read_only_resume branch and skips Save. last_safe_history_observation records only booleans and counts, not labels, row IDs, URL, or audit content.
